verdict.rationale: Wave documents a narrow bulk feature (uploading up to 10 receipts at once with OCR), but there is no evidence of broader bulk operations (e.g., bulk invoice creation/edits, bulk transaction updates) or any API/CLI/MCP surface an AI-native user could script against — the developer portal is crawl-walled and no OpenAPI/llms.txt exists. missing for 10: bulk invoice/transaction/customer operations, programmatic API or CLI access for scripted bulk actions, evidence beyond the 10-item receipt cap.
